clips.title: The story
paras: Near Lakeshire's bridge, Guard Howe watches the road and seeks fighters against the Blackrock orcs. A personal vendetta drives him to offer bounties for proof of their defeat.

Guard Howe keeps watch just south of the stone bridge over Lake Everstill, near the heart of Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs press into the Redridge Mountains, and Howe sees them as a threat to the valley. He holds a bitter grudge against the clan and recruits passing fighters to hunt orcs in the eastern hills. In return, he offers pay for proof that they have been defeated.
